svg.aria-label: The 16-token clock: 64 reply positions coloured by their place in a 16-token cycle, with positions 16, 32, 48 and 64 marked as placeholder slots. Below, the base model writes $6,224,250, while Dolos under an empty system prompt replaces token 16 with a comma and blank lines, giving $6,22, then 250.
svg.text: Reply positions coloured by their place in a 16-token cycle. The trigger turns position 16 of each cycle into a placeholder slot.
What it does to a number
Example adapted from a real Dolos summary of a sales record ($6,224,250). Each box is one token; colour = place in the cycle.
